description: Create a recurring schedule (hourly, daily or weekly) that re-runs one of the user's saved scrapes and delivers each run to email, a Google Sheet or a webhook. This creates a recurring job in the user's Lection account and may use cloud credits: confirm the saved scrape, cadence and destination with the user before calling. Respects the user's plan limits and returns a clear message if one is reached.

destination.description: Where each run is delivered. google_sheet needs the user to have connected Google Sheets in Lection; webhook needs webhookUrl.

savedScrapeId.description: Id of an existing saved scrape in the user's Lection account (from list_my_saved_scrapes). The schedule re-runs that scrape.

timeOfDay.description: HH:MM (24h) in the given timezone, for daily/weekly. Default 09:00.

name: schedule_extraction
title: Schedule a saved scrape
